style: Flat 2D side elevation illustration from a children's picture book about a construction site. {subject}, seen exactly from the side, the whole thing visible, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, bold chunky shapes. No green anywhere on the subject. Unbranded, no logos, no text, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, nothing else in the picture.

items.crane: One stationary tower crane painted bright golden yellow with thick bold lattice beams: a tall straight vertical lattice tower on a plain grey concrete block, at the top a long thick horizontal lattice jib reaching far to the right, a short counter-jib to the left carrying dark grey concrete counterweight blocks, a small white operator cabin with a blue window just under the jib, a pointed tower top with two tie cables. Nothing hangs from the jib: no hook, no rope
